table_title: List the top 5 worldwide-grossing films of the 1990s with worldwide gross in USD and release year.
db_analog: SELECT decade, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY decade ORDER BY worldwide_gross_usd DESC) AS rank, film, worldwide_gross_usd, release_year FROM films WHERE decade IN ('1980s','1990s','2000s','2010s') QUALIFY rank <= 5 ORDER BY decade, rank
temporal_note: Wikipedia per-decade '[decade]_in_film' articles accessed 2026-04-27. Worldwide gross figures are taken from the 'List of worldwide highest-grossing films' table on each decade page; values reflect lifetime worldwide gross at the time of fetch and may include theatrical re-release earnings (e.g., Avatar's $2.92B includes its 2022 re-release; Titanic's $1.84B includes the 2012 3D and later re-releases). The top-5 ordering itself is stable; the absolute gross values may shift with future re-releases or with Wikipedia table updates.
_extraction_notes: Derived from top_grossing_films_worldwide_per_decade_1980s_2010s by deterministic filter/projection on the parent CSV. Decade filter == 1990s.
